artworks.title: Shield with Stag, Held by Wild Man
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body figure of a person standing in profile, leaning forward with one leg raised and bent. The person has a large, thick beard and long hair adorned with a wreath of leaves. They are not wearing clothing. In one hand, they hold a shield with a deer image. The background features a mountainous landscape, and the scene is enclosed in a circular frame. The initials "M S" are located near the bottom of the circular edge. No other objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Shields with Rabbit and Moor's Head, Held by Wild Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7.7 x 7.9 cm (3 1/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a circular print depicting a man standing between two shield-shaped objects, one decorated with a rabbit and the other with a person's head. The man in the center is covered in short, wavy fur. Only his face and feet are bare. He has a curly beard and curly hair adorned with a crown of leafy twigs. His arms are stretched out to either side, where he holds the edges of the two shields, which appear to be balanced on rocky ledges. The left shield depicts a rabbit in mid-leap, facing the right. The other side shows a person in profile, facing the left. They are wearing a high-necked garment and have short, curly hair tied up with a cloth. The scene is enclosed within a circular border.

artworks.title: A Bishop's Crosier
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an ornate staff or crozier. The top part of the staff features a circular frame with a seated figure holding a smaller figure in their lap within an elaborate archway. The frame is decorated with swirling, ornamental patterns. The handle of the staff has delicate vertical lines and is crowned with a complex structure with carved figures. The drawing demonstrates the artist's skill in detailed, linear drawing typical of the Gothic art style.

artworks.title: A Censer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.3 x 21.2 cm (12 5/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an intricately designed incense burner with gothic architecture and detailed figures in the center. The color palette is primarily monochrome, with black and gray against a beige background. The burner is in the center, with chains extending outward and resting on the surface beneath it.

artworks.title: Ornament with Hop Vine
artworks.description: The image is an intricate arrangement of swirling lines and curling shapes that crisscross and overlap, creating an abstract pattern. The lines resemble tendrils and leaves, forming a dense, ornate design that evokes a garden. The organic shapes suggest grapes on a vine or hops on a trellis, weaving a tapestry across the surface.

artworks.title: Thistle Ornament
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricate design of flowing, swirling lines forming a graceful, abstract pattern. The shapes resemble twisting vines or curling leaves, suggesting elements of nature stylized in an ornate manner. The curves and points create an effect reminiscent of a delicate botanical motif or elaborate ironwork. The detailed and sinuous design invites a comparison to the fluid and intricate forms found in nature, while maintaining its abstract and artistic presentation.

artworks.title: Leaf Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays long, flowing lines in an intricate pattern. The abstract design resembles curling tendrils or swirling waves. The black lines against the light background create a sense of movement. The delicate curves and loops can be likened to the exaggerated curls of smoke rising and twisting.

artworks.title: Ornament with Owl Mocked by Day Birds
Christ and His Disciples I
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in arched niches with intricate patterns and floral motifs. Each man has a beard and a halo-like circle behind their head. The man on the left holds a book and a key, the central figure holds a staff and an object resembling a palette, and the figure on the right is reading from a large book. Above their heads are medallions of profile faces, and angelic figures flank each niche.

artworks.title: Christ and His Disciples II
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white illustration divided into three sections, each featuring a full-body depiction of a male figure. The figures stand within ornate archways adorned with intricate floral patterns and celestial imagery. In the left section, the man stands solemnly, gazing forward, with long wavy hair, a heavily draped garment, holding an orb and a cross. In the middle section, another man with long hair is holding a large key and an open book, with a halo above his head. The right section shows a man turned slightly to the side, holding a large crossbeam, with a beard, halo, and long robe. Surrounding each man are intricate columns with designs mimicking classical architecture, accompanied by smaller angelic figures holding them up. The scene is rich with religious and symbolic motifs, set within a decorative border framing the figures.

artworks.title: Christ and His Disciples III
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a triptych featuring three religious figures in archways. The artwork consists of three panels, each featuring a figure standing under an ornate arch. The figures are adorned in robes and accompanied by various religious and symbolic attributes like a staff, a chalice, and foliage. Architectural details can be seen, such as columns and floral motifs, giving the artwork a structured and formal appearance. In the background of each panel, other elements can be observed, such as clouds and buildings. The composition suggests a reverential and ceremonial theme.

artworks.title: Christ and His Disciples IV
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures in arched alcoves with intricate floral and decorative motifs. The figure on the left faces forward, with long, curly hair and a full beard, wearing a robe and holding a square tool. The middle figure is bearded with long hair, standing in profile holding a staff and dressed in robes. The figure on the right has curly hair and a beard, holding a staff and gesticulating with their other hand. The surroundings include columns with capitals and mythical or decorative figures. The background depicts scenes with smaller figures, landscapes, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Christ and His Disciples V
artworks.description: This is a woodcut print of three religious scenes under arches. The print features intricate architectural detailing framing three panels. The left panel displays a robed figure with a large staff and halo, standing amidst a rocky landscape with military figures on horseback. The central panel shows another robed figure holding a staff in front of a tree, surrounded by smaller figures. The right panel depicts several figures walking with staffs under a heavenly figure in the sky. The scenes are divided by ornate columns crowned with figures blending human and mythical characteristics. The print's style reflects religious themes of the Renaissance period, with detailed figures and ornate structures.

artworks.title: Double Portrait of Israhel van Meckenem and His Wife Ida
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 x 17.5 cm (5 1/8 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man and a woman, displaying their head and shoulders. The man is on the left, slightly turned towards the woman, and the woman is on the right, facing the man. The man has prominent cheekbones, a long nose, a pronounced brow, and slightly downcast eyes. His hair is mostly covered by a cloth cap. The woman has a round face with delicate features, including a small mouth and eyes looking slightly downwards. Her hair is completely covered by a similar cloth cap. Both are dressed in simple garments. The background has an ornate pattern resembling foliage or scrollwork, rendered in a darker tone. Decorative text is visible at the bottom, but it is blurred and indiscernible.

artworks.title: Samson and the Lion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 10.5 cm (5 3/8 x 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on their right knee while leaning forward. They have a focused expression and long, curly hair. The person is wearing a long-sleeved garment with a belt, and their head is wrapped with a cloth that drapes down their back. They are interacting with a lion, holding its jaws open with their hands. In the background, there is a rocky landscape with a castle-like structure situated atop a large rock formation. The setting features a plain surface with some rocks or earth.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Martin Schongauer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic visitation. The drawing depicts an angel engaging with a figure draped in robes in front of a curtained space. A radiant figure at the top is surrounded by beams of light, and a dove hovers near the robed figure. The angel appears to be making a gesture toward the figure. There are elements such as a floral motif and a small lectern-like object in the corner. The linear style and shading emphasize the divine nature of the encounter.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: The image is of a woman kneeling with her hands clasped together near her chest. She has long, wavy hair, a gentle expression, and is wearing flowing robes. Beside her, there is a baby swaddled in cloth on straw, with a donkey and an ox. In the background are two trees, a small building or wall, and distant figures.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene with three figures. The central figure is nailed to a cross. To the left stands a figure in robes with a halo. To the right, another figure with a halo and long hair stands holding a garment. The background includes rolling hills and a simple structure in the distance.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: engraving with traces of hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a depiction of Jesus Christ on the cross, with figures representing Mary and John the Apostle. Jesus is central, nailed to the cross with arms outstretched, with a somber expression. Mary is to the left in long robes, while John is on the right. Six angels surround Jesus, some holding instruments of the passion, and one kneeling near His feet. Skulls and bones are scattered below the cross. The background is intricate with swirling patterns and halos around Mary's and John's heads.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is Jesus Christ on the cross, with his arms outstretched and head tilted to one side. He wears a crown of thorns and a cloth around his waist. To the left is a woman with a sorrowful expression, wearing a veil and robes. To the right is a younger man with curly hair, gesturing with one hand. Both figures also have halos. The background is simple and neutral, drawing attention to the figures.

artworks.title: The Birth of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with various figures engaged in domestic activities. The drawing showcases a room with a bed in the foreground, on which an infant is held by a seated figure. Several vessels are positioned near a wooden tub that rests on the ground. A figure stands adjacent to a table, appearing to pour liquid from a jug into another container. Beyond the figures, an architectural scene unfolds in the background with a couple engaging on a staircase that leads outside, hinting at an exterior with a fence and tree. The drawing is characterized by intricate line work and hatching that conveys texture and depth. This composition captures a moment of household activity, combining elements of care, domestic chores, and interaction.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior scene with a ceremonial event. The composition is split into two parts: the foreground shows figures in elaborate garments engaged in a ritual, while the background features a grand architectural setting with columns, a platform, an altar, candles, and figures in the distance. The scene conveys a formal and ceremonial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in an interior setting. The central figure, a bearded man in ornate robes and a mitre, is holding a small, nude infant towards a woman in flowing robes. Surrounding them are other figures, both male and female, in period-appropriate clothing. The setting includes architectural elements like a tiled floor and a decorative pillar with a gothic arch pattern. In the background, more figures are engaged in various activities, with detailed surroundings including candle holders and a small gallery above. The image is rendered in a tonal, etched style.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historic scene with many figures involved in a dramatic event with infants. The drawing shows a ruler or king seated on a throne, observing chaos and turmoil. Adult figures are standing and moving around, some holding infants. The lower part of the composition shows several infants in different positions. Women appear to be pleading or protecting other infants. In the background, there are horses and additional figures. The drawing is highly detailed with intricate linework typical of engravings or etchings. The atmosphere is tense, capturing a moment of historical or biblical significance.
